name: @jmouse/file-handling
description: What a file is, with nothing to install for it: its family and how it may be shown, its size as people read it, why a request about it failed, and how fetched bytes are saved. No React, no kit — the decisions @jmouse/ui-kit, @jmouse/explorer and @jmouse/files all read.
author: Ivan Hontarenko
